name: pdfintake
description: Turn scans, phone photos and PDFs into small, searchable PDFs on your own computer: lossless image-to-PDF, an OCR text layer, lossless shrinking, and a smaller copy only when you ask for one. English is built in, and French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai and Vietnamese are language packs, downloaded the first time a document needs one.
